item.title: 1. Internship Worklog
item.description: WEEKLY INTERNSHIP WORKLOG Program: Workforce Bootcamp - First Cloud AI Journey A detailed record of tasks, learning modules, training sessions, and achievements throughout the 12-week internship at AWS Vietnam. 12-Week Roadmap Summary: Week 1 - Week 4: Initialization, familiarization with the AWS environment, and research into foundational services (EC2, S3, Git, VPC). Week 5 - Week 8: Advanced infrastructure deployment (Load Balancer, Auto Scaling, RDS, Docker) and design of the Website project architecture. Week 9 - Week 12: System authorization (IAM Roles), optimization (CDN, CI/CD), finalization of project features, and completion of the internship report. Select a specific week from the left menu or click on the list below to view details.

item.title: Proposal
item.description: SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE PROPOSAL PROJECT: AI E-COMMERCE PLATFORM — AWS SERVERLESS ARCHITECTURE 1. INTRODUCTION & PROBLEM STATEMENT 1.1. Cloud-native and Decoupled Architecture Trends Entering 2026, the global e-commerce industry is witnessing a massive transition from traditional monolithic architectures to Cloud-native and decoupled/event-driven architectures. Fierce competition demands that online retail platforms adapt rapidly to market shifts, handle massive traffic spikes during peak sales seasons without downtime, and ensure high operational agility.

item.title: Blogs Posted
item.description: This section lists and introduces the blogs you have posted in the AWS Study Group. Blog 1 - Simplify AWS AppSync Events integration with Powertools for AWS Lambda This blog introduces a new AppSyncEventsResolver feature in Powertools for AWS Lambda (supported in Python, TypeScript, and .NET), which simplifies integration with AWS AppSync Events for real-time applications such as chat apps, dashboards, or IoT systems.

item.title: Workshop
item.description: AWS CDK & Serverless Architecture: Building a Serverless Event-Driven Application Welcome to the AWS hands-on lab! In this workshop, you will build and deploy a modern, scalable, and secure Serverless Event-Driven Architecture using AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) in TypeScript. Workshop Contents Workshop Overview Prerequisites & Setup Module 1: Storage & Database Module 2: Compute & API Gateway Module 3: Security & Permissions Module 4: Serverless Backend & AWS SDK v3 Deployment & Testing Clean-up Advanced
